controls.title: Versioned Community governance and maintainer review
controls.evidence_artifact: governance revision, maintainers and review record
controls.automated_test: repository manifest verifies governance files; maintainer review remains external

controls.title: Owned Community product risk register
controls.evidence_artifact: versioned risks with owner, score, treatment and due date

controls.title: Repository maintainer access and account protection
controls.evidence_artifact: maintainer list, MFA status and access review

controls.title: DCO, independent review, required CI and reviewed source release
controls.evidence_artifact: DCO result, review, required checks and release qualification
controls.automated_test: local gate validates DCO and release contracts; source-host enforcement remains external

controls.title: Reviewed diff, exact source revision and qualification chain
controls.evidence_artifact: commit OID, Git tree, test commands and qualification artifact
controls.automated_test: community candidate test binds qualification evidence to the exact tree; the reviewed result remains external release evidence

controls.title: Rust and Local Web dependency, advisory, secret and license checks
controls.evidence_artifact: Rust cargo-deny/cargo-audit/license output, Local Web npm audit and repository secret scan
controls.automated_test: scripts/verify-community.sh runs the Rust and Local Web checks; experimental IDE fixtures are outside this control

controls.title: Encrypted, append-only local execution audit
controls.evidence_artifact: encrypted scoped events and verified hash chain
controls.automated_test: storage tests verify encryption, chain validation and mutation rejection; operational review remains external

controls.title: Documented local and model-provider data boundaries
controls.evidence_artifact: data flows, encryption tests and provider-boundary documentation
controls.automated_test: privacy/security use cases verify local controls; provider retention remains user-selected

controls.title: Community vulnerability intake and coordinated disclosure
controls.evidence_artifact: private report handling and disclosure exercise
controls.automated_test: SECURITY.md presence is checked; response exercise remains external

controls.title: Local backup, integrity verification and atomic restore
controls.evidence_artifact: database integrity, backup digest, restore and rollback test results
controls.automated_test: storage and daemon tests cover online backup, keyed restore and rollback; a released-build restore exercise remains external

controls.title: User-selected model provider and source-host disclosure
controls.automated_test: vendor decisions cannot be inferred from local source tests

controls.title: Accurate Community security and release documentation
controls.evidence_artifact: security model, support policy and preview limitations
controls.automated_test: documentation link and Community tree checks run in the source gate

risks.treatment: Explicit provider configuration, documented boundary and user-selected provider terms
OS sandbox, default network deny, fail-closed startup and boundary tests
Locked dependencies, advisory/license/secret checks and reviewed source tags
MFA, minimal maintainer access, required review and protected source releases

data_flows.retention_policy: Determined by the user-selected provider contract and account settings; S-Code cannot assert zero retention
data_flows.approval_control: explicit local provider configuration and provider policy

data_flows.purpose: optional external tool and resource access
data_flows.retention_policy: Determined by the configured MCP server; S-Code does not control remote retention
data_flows.approval_control: explicit installation, endpoint and permission confirmation; each tool call remains policy mediated

data_flows.purpose: optional source control, work management, chat, CI or security integration
data_flows.retention_policy: Determined by each configured external service and organization contract
data_flows.approval_control: explicit connector configuration, scoped action validation and credential handle

data_flows.retention_policy: Retained until the user deletes or replaces the local database; no automatic 30-day purge is implemented
data_flows.approval_control: local encryption, append-only trigger and hash-chain verification

exercises.evidence: Record an exact released revision, command output and retained restore digest before claiming a completed release exercise
Record a private vulnerability intake and coordinated disclosure tabletop
